## Concrete result

1. **Explicit transparent observation panes.** Baseline cel shader forces alpha 1; ArtBatch merges opaque vertex-coloured geometry. Split intended panes into explicit named material batches instead of treating every `P.glass` colour as transparent. Root owns reconciliation of the minimum render-only factory signature changes across the assigned files. Use shared scene-owned material instances with bounded allocation/disposal and fog-aware glass. Check depth testing and transparent ordering against water, other panes and the hull from inside and outside.
2. **Real sightlines with unchanged seals.** VISUAL must identify exact pane locations and any opaque backing geometry. An alpha pane pasted over a solid opaque wall is not a window. Segment only visible wall artwork around framed glass, preserving authoritative solid collision and dry boundaries: glass remains a barrier, not an invisible doorway. Do not globally hide walls or water to make one capture pass. Through dry carrier/lab windows, the outside ocean must retain depth attenuation; disabling local wet effects must not make the deep exterior look above water.
3. **Depth-aware Canopy atmosphere.** Reproduce VISUAL's staged player base `(129,-112,-105)`, yaw `.34`, pitch `.04`; distinguish base from actual camera/eye position. The baseline uses a finite 680 m water plane and sky attenuation without optical depth. Resolve the visible plane edge/bright sky discontinuity with coherent depth/surface haze and sun attenuation, preserving the bright shallows, island skyline, useful light direction and readable wildlife/return landmarks. More global fog is not sufficient if it erases navigation. Confirm above-water, near-waterline, shallow, deep and dry-refuge views in motion.
4. **Recognizable first-person Dart piloting.** The current exterior is wholly hidden while controlled and the camera follows saved player pose plus piloting eye height. Provide a coherent hull-local seat/forward view with canopy frame and modest mechanical context, clear central navigation and visible approaches. Retain existing look/steering semantics; derive any view-only offset without mutating saved poses or collider origins. Separate controlled cockpit visibility from external hull presentation. No third-person/free-look system, near-plane clipping, swimming-in-open-water disguise, HUD obscuration or speculative controls. Preserve boarding/exit/refusal/save behavior. Validate the Canopy route's visibility with the final camera.

Any shared change beyond these render seams returns to root before implementation. Keep fixes as small coherent commits; no competing copies of registry, physical layout or camera authority. Update CONTRACTS only through root after exact interfaces are returned.
